items.title: Vontier Strengthens Fleet Connectivity Solutions With EKOS Acquisition
items.summary: Vontier Corporation (NYSE: VNT), a leading global provider of critical technologies and solutions to connect, manage and scale the mobility ecosystem, today announced its acquisition of EKOS, a leading provider of cloud-connected fleet, fuel and electric vehicle (EV) management software. The acquisition will deepen the company’s leading fleet platform, providing a connected, end-to-end solution for operators. EKOS provides fleet operators with centralized visibility across fuel procurement, site monitoring, fleet asset management, fuel card controls and EV charging infrastructure – all from a single connected interface. Trusted by thousands of businesses, EKOS currently supports more than 1.2 million vehicles across the U.S., helping operators reduce costs, create efficiency and scale operations without added complexity. items.title: Vontier Debuts on Newsweek’s World’s Greenest Companies List
items.summary: Vontier Corporation (NYSE: VNT), a leading global provider of critical technologies and solutions to connect, manage and scale the mobility ecosystem, today announced that it was named one of Newsweek’s World’s Greenest Companies for 2026 . This is the first year the company was included on the selective list, following earlier recognition on Newsweek’s lists of America’s Greenest and Most Responsible Companies. Inclusion on the global list represents a higher level of international distinction, requiring Vontier’s operations to meet 25 rigorous EU sustainability criteria. “At Vontier, we see sustainability as smart business – driving efficiency, accountability and long-term value,” said Katie Rowen, EVP and Chief Transformation and Operations Officer at Vontier. “Throughout the year, we’ve mobilized hundreds of colleagues across the globe to identify and implement practical efficiency gains, creating a ripple effect of transformative change. items.title: Vontier Completes Divestiture of Teletrac Navman
items.summary: Vontier Corporation (NYSE: VNT), a leading global provider of critical technologies and solutions to connect, manage and scale the mobility ecosystem, today announced the completion of the previously announced sale of a majority of Teletrac Navman, its global fleet management, telematics and asset management business. As previously disclosed, the total transaction is valued at $220 million including cash proceeds to Vontier of approximately $80 million. In anticipation of these proceeds and consistent with its stated capital allocation policy, Vontier has completed share repurchases of $130 million during the second quarter. Financial results for the Teletrac business have historically been reported within the Mobility Technologies segment of Vontier and will now be excluded from continuing operations as of the completion date – June 30, 2026. items.summary: Vontier Corporation (NYSE: VNT), a leading global provider of critical technologies and solutions to connect, manage and scale the mobility ecosystem, has been named to TIME's " World's Most Sustainable Companies 2026 ,” for the third year in a row.
